allow: Shell(php artisan serve --port=8080 > /tmp/serve.log 2>&1 & sleep 3; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login; echo; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login | grep -o "admin panel" | head -1)

Shell(cd /tmp && rm -f cookies.txt && CSRF=$(curl -s -c cookies.txt http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login | grep -o 'name="_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login -d "_token=$CSRF&email=admin@midland.com&password=password" -L)

Shell(cd /tmp && CSRF=$(curl -s -c cookies.txt http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login | grep -o 'name="_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//') && echo "CSRF: ${CSRF:0:20}..." && curl -s -b cookies.txt -c cookies.txt -o /dev/null -w "login POST: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/login -d "_token=$CSRF&email=admin@midland.com&password=password" && curl -s -b cookies.txt -o /dev/null -w "dashboard: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:8080/admin/dashboard)
